QKVParallelLinear.partition_dimension: output dim (0): heads and kv-heads partitioned/replicated across tp ranks
QKVParallelLinear.weight_loader_behavior: loads separate q/k/v checkpoint tensors into offset slices of one fused [q_size+kv_size+kv_size, hidden] parameter, per-rank via narrow(output_dim, tp_rank*shard_size, shard_size)
QKVParallelLinear.output_contract: rank-local qkv output width = (num_heads+2*num_kv_heads)*head_size, kept sharded (gather_output=False)
QKVParallelLinear.collective_behavior: none at the qkv_proj boundary itself (kept sharded for the attention op); the row-parallel o_proj after attention performs the all_reduce
QKVParallelLinear.bias_handling: Qwen2Attention hardcodes bias=True for qkv_proj regardless of config.attention_bias; bias is sharded per-rank identically to the weight (output_dim=0)
QKVParallelLinear.kv_head_special_handling: see rank_local_weight_shape_rule; for Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (total_num_kv_heads=2) at tp_size=2, tp_size==total_num_kv_heads so num_kv_head_replicas=divide(2,2)=1 -- structurally the 'replicate' branch executes but degenerates to a clean 1:1 partition (rank0 owns kv head 0, rank1 owns kv head 1, zero actual duplication)

RowParallelLinear.rank_local_weight_shape_rule: input_size_per_partition = divide(input_size, tp_size); weight shape [output_size, input_size_per_partition]
RowParallelLinear.output_contract: Y = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(X_rank @ W_rank^T [+ bias on rank 0 only])
RowParallelLinear.bias_handling: bias is fused into rank 0's local GEMM ONLY (bias_ = None if tp_rank>0), so after all_reduce the bias has been added exactly once
RowParallelLinear.verification_excerpt: bias_ = None if (self.tp_rank > 0 or self.skip_bias_add) else self.bias

MergedColumnParallelLinear.partition_dimension: output dim (0), independently per merged sub-weight (gate, up)
MergedColumnParallelLinear.weight_loader_behavior: each of gate_proj/up_proj is loaded into its own contiguous output-dim slice of the fused gate_up_proj parameter, at the SAME per-rank shard index for both -- so a given rank's gate shard and up shard cover the identical intermediate-dimension indices
MergedColumnParallelLinear.rank_local_weight_shape_rule: each output_size in output_sizes must be tp-divisible; per-rank shard width = output_size // tp_size for each of gate/up independently
MergedColumnParallelLinear.output_contract: rank-local [gate_rank | up_rank] concatenated on output dim, kept sharded
MergedColumnParallelLinear.collective_behavior: none at this boundary (kept sharded); matching shard ownership makes the elementwise SiLU(gate_rank)*up_rank rank-local-valid

VocabParallelEmbedding.partition_dimension: vocab dim (0) of the embedding table
VocabParallelEmbedding.weight_loader_behavior: narrow(output_dim, start_idx, shard_size) per rank vocab range
VocabParallelEmbedding.output_contract: masked local lookup (out-of-range token ids masked to 0) then tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce to reconstruct the correct row for every token regardless of which rank owns it

ParallelLMHead_and_LogitsProcessor.partition_dimension: vocab dim (0) of the (possibly tied) lm_head weight
ParallelLMHead_and_LogitsProcessor.weight_loader_behavior: same vocab-shard loading as VocabParallelEmbedding; for this model tie_word_embeddings=True so lm_head literally IS embed_tokens (Qwen2ForCausalLM sets self.lm_head = self.model.embed_tokens)
ParallelLMHead_and_LogitsProcessor.rank_local_weight_shape_rule: identical vocab shard boundaries as embed_tokens (tied weight)
ParallelLMHead_and_LogitsProcessor.output_contract: local_logits = hidden_states @ W_vocab_shard^T; full logits = concat_over_ranks(local_logits) via all-gather, then trimmed to org_vocab_size to drop any padding
ParallelLMHead_and_LogitsProcessor.collective_behavior: tensor_model_parallel_all_gather (or tensor_model_parallel_gather) along the last (vocab) dimension -- NOT all_reduce; this is the one family that needs concatenation-style reconstruction
ParallelLMHead_and_LogitsProcessor.bias_handling: ParallelLMHead bias defaults to False and Qwen2ForCausalLM does not enable it

tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce.output_contract: elementwise sum across all tp ranks' local tensors, result replicated to all ranks
tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce.collective_behavior: all_reduce(sum) over the tp process group

tensor_model_parallel_all_gather.output_contract: concatenation of every rank's local tensor along dim=-1, in rank order
tensor_model_parallel_all_gather.collective_behavior: all_gather along the last dimension over the tp process group

discovery_method: direct introspection of the installed vLLM package's own source files (inspect.getsourcefile + literal excerpt extraction), not documentation or memory
